corrections.reason: In the Ge'ez citation from Job 9:7 ('ወገጸ ከዋክብት የሐትም'), the construct state noun is 'ወገጸ' (1st order ጸ, straight legs), not 6th order 'ጽ'.

Both visually on the page (4th order ራ with left-curving base) and philologically in the classic Qene/Andemta citation ('በከመ የሐትሙ እለ የሐትሙ መዓረ ግራ በማኅተመ ወርቅ'), the word is 'ግራ' (of the field/wild honey), not 'ግሩ'.

The first word is the variant Ge'ez reading 'ንረሲ' (matching L33 'ምንተ ንረሲ'), where 'ረ' was misread as 'ፈ', and the imperfective Amharic gloss is 'እናደርጋለን' (with 1st order ደ, contrasting with jussive 'እናድርግ' on L36).
